set tsc= $$$ERROR("GrpRelation Not found") set errorMsg = " Group Relationship Not found " _ senderId _ "->" _ receiverId $$$TRACE( "-- Find GS GrpRelation --" _ senderId _ "->" _ receiverId _ ", Version: " _ version)
&sql(DECLARE WPCursor CURSOR FOR select r.ID, r.name from IHC_TPManage.TRADELINKS r, IHC_TPManage.TPIDS gs1, IHC_TPManage.TPIDS gs2, IHC_TPManage.TRANSACTIONTYPES tr where r.GsSenderId = gs1.ID and r.GsReceiverId = gs2.ID and r.TRANSTYPE = tr.ID and gs1.TPID = :senderId and gs2.TPID = :receiverId and tr.VERSION = :version and r.Mode = :mode and r.Direction = :direction and r.Active = 1 ) &sql(OPEN WPCursor) if (SQLCODE'=0) RETURN tsc FOR { &sql(FETCH WPCursor into :id, :relNm) QUIT:SQLCODE set errorMsg = " FOUND relationship for GS: " _ relNm _", " _ senderId _", " _ receiverId _", " _ gsDocType _", " _ version set tpObj.GrpRelationID = id set tpObj.GRPRELATIONSHIPNAME = relNm set tsc= $$$OK } &sql(CLOSE WPCursor)
return tsc

set tsc= $$$ERROR("TP Not found") set errorMsg = "; TP Not found: " _ tpid
&sql(DECLARE WPCursor CURSOR FOR SELECT NAME, TPID FROM IHC_TPManage.TPIDS where TPID= :tpid)
&sql(OPEN WPCursor) QUIT:(SQLCODE'=0) FOR { &sql(FETCH WPCursor into :tpNm, :TPIDSIP) QUIT:SQLCODE

Method.Implementation:
set tSC = $$$OK set x12Obj = ##class(IHC.ITF.Process.Bpl.X12Parser).%New() Do x12Obj.OnInit(ConfigName)
Set TempName = ##class(%Library.File).TempFilename("x12") set tIOStream = ##class(%IO.FileStream).%New() Do tIOStream.Open(TempName, "N") if ('$IsObject(tIOStream)) { set tSC = $$$ERROR($$$ObjectScriptError, "Could not create IOStream") QUIT tSC }
Do tIOStream.Write(request.OutputToString(),1, .stat) if ($$$ISERR(stat)) { set tSC = $$$ERROR($$$ObjectScriptError, "Could not write to IOStream") QUIT tSC } Do tIOStream.Rewind() Do tIOStream.Close()
$$$TRACE("Call OnProcessInput")
set tSC = x12Obj.OnProcessInput(TempName, .pOut, .list) if ($$$ISERR(tSC)) { Do ##class(%File).Delete(TempName) set tSC = $$$ERROR($$$ObjectScriptError, "OnProcessInput failed") QUIT tSC } set reqList = list set x12RecInfo.statMsg = pOut
Do ##class(%File).Delete(TempName) $$$TRACE(tSC _ ", List from x12Obj.OnProcessInput has " _ list.Count() _ " docs")
return tSC
